description: Check npm packages for security advisories. Start here before installing, upgrading or deploying: send 1 to 50 package names (never versions) and get, per package, its total and up to 20 advisories of the last 120 days, newest first, each with vulnerable ranges, fixed versions and the conditions that make it exploitable. A package with none returns total 0. Compare the ranges with your lockfile. For one advisory in full use get_advisory; for the version to upgrade to, use latest_safe.

packages.description: npm package names as written in package.json, 1 to 50, for example ["next", "@supabase/supabase-js"]. Names only, never versions: compare the returned ranges with your lockfile.

name: get_advisories
title: Advisories for packages
